question: 请用3-5句英语描述一个晴朗的周末，你在公园里看到什么？人们在做什么？
answer: It is a sunny weekend. I go to the park. I see many people there. Some children are flying kites. Some old people are doing exercise. Everyone is happy.

question: 请用3-5句英语描述你喜欢去的地方（如图书馆、公园、商店），你为什么喜欢去那里？
answer: I like going to the library. It is quiet and clean. There are many books there. I can read my favorite books. I go there every Saturday.

question: 请用英语介绍你自己。写3-5句话，包括你的名字、年龄、喜欢的食物或运动。
answer: My name is Li Ming. I am 10 years old. I like playing basketball. My favorite food is noodles.

question: 请用英语介绍你最喜欢的一天（星期几），为什么喜欢？这天你通常做什么？写3-5句话。
answer: My favorite day is Saturday. I don't go to school on Saturday. I usually play with my friends. We play football in the park.

question: 请用英语介绍你最好的朋友。写3-5句话，包括他/她的名字、长相、喜欢做什么。
answer: My best friend is Tom. He is tall and thin. He has big eyes. He likes playing chess. We often play together after school.

question: 请用英语描述四季中你最喜欢的一个季节。为什么喜欢？在这个季节你通常做什么？写3-5句话。
answer: I like spring best. The weather is warm. Flowers are everywhere. I often go to the park with my family. We have a picnic under the tree.

question: 请用英语写一段关于你的家庭的短文。写3-5句话，你家有几口人？他们做什么工作？你爱你的家吗？
answer: There are three people in my family. My father is a teacher. My mother is a doctor. I am a student. I love my family very much.

question: 请用英语描述你昨天做了什么。写3-5句话，用过去时态。
answer: Yesterday I got up at 7 o'clock. I had breakfast at home. I went to school by bus. After school I did my homework. I went to bed at 9 o'clock.

question: 请用3-5句英语描述你在课间休息时通常做什么？你和同学一起玩吗？
answer: During the break, I usually play with my friends. We play games in the playground. Sometimes we run and jump. We drink water and eat snacks. We have a lot of fun.

question: 请用3-5句英语写一写你在家里帮爸爸妈妈做什么家务？你觉得做家务怎么样？
answer: I often help my mother at home. I clean my room. I wash the dishes after dinner. Sometimes I sweep the floor. I think doing housework is good. It makes me helpful.

question: 请用英语写一写你喜欢的动物。它是什么？长什么样？你喜欢它什么？写3-5句话。
answer: I like dogs very much. I have a pet dog. It is white and small. It has big ears. It likes to play with me. It is my best friend.

question: 请用英语描述你的教室。它大吗？里面有什么？你喜欢你的教室吗？写3-5句话。
answer: My classroom is big and clean. There are many desks and chairs in it. There is a blackboard on the wall. There are some pictures too. I like my classroom.

question: 请用英语写一写你上学期的暑假。你去了哪里？做了什么？开心吗？写3-5句话，用过去时态。
answer: Last summer holiday I went to the beach with my family. We swam in the sea. We ate seafood. I played with sand. It was a great holiday.

question: 请用英语介绍你喜欢的食物。你喜欢吃什么？为什么？你妈妈会做吗？写3-5句话。
answer: I like dumplings very much. They are delicious. My mother can make dumplings. We often eat dumplings on weekends. I also like fruit, like apples and bananas.

question: 请用3-5句英语写一写你每天早上上学前做了什么。几点起床？吃什么？怎么去学校？
answer: I get up at seven o'clock every morning. I brush my teeth and wash my face. I have breakfast at home. I eat bread and drink milk. Then I go to school by bus.

question: 请用英语写一写你的周末。你通常在周末做什么？和谁一起？开心吗？写3-5句话。
answer: On weekends I usually get up late. I do my homework in the morning. In the afternoon I play with my friends. Sometimes I watch TV. I like weekends very much.

question: 请用英语描述你喜欢的运动。你经常做这个运动吗？和谁一起？为什么喜欢？写3-5句话。
answer: I like playing basketball. I play it every day after school. I play with my classmates. It makes me strong and healthy. It is very interesting.

question: 请用英语写一封信给圣诞老人，告诉他你今年表现好不好，你想要什么礼物。写3-5句话。
answer: Dear Santa, How are you? I am a good girl this year. I study hard. I help my mother at home. I want a new bike for Christmas. Thank you!

question: 请用3-5句英语描述下雨天的情景。你喜欢下雨吗？下雨天你通常做什么？
answer: It is raining today. The sky is gray. I can hear the rain outside. I like rainy days because I can stay at home. I usually read books and listen to music. Sometimes I watch TV with my family.

question: 请用英语描述你的学校。它大不大？你最喜欢学校的哪个地方？写3-5句话。
answer: My school is very big. There are many trees and flowers. The playground is very large. I like the library best. There are many books in it. I love my school.

question: 请用英语写一段关于健康饮食的短文。我们应该吃什么？不应该吃什么？写3-5句话。
answer: We should eat healthy food. We should eat more vegetables and fruit. We should drink milk every day. We should not eat too much candy. Healthy food makes us strong.
